feedback.text: The workshops were incredibly well organized. Learned a lot about machine learning!
The microphone kept cutting out during the keynote. Half the audience couldn't hear anything.
Registration was smooth and the venue was easy to find.
The food stalls ran out of food by 1pm. Totally unacceptable for a full-day event.
Speakers were great but the schedule kept slipping. Sessions started 30 minutes late.
Amazing experience overall! Would definitely attend next year.
The AR/VR demo zone was the highlight. Please add more interactive exhibits next time.
The event was okay. Nothing particularly stood out to me.
Our team won second place! The problem statement was challenging and relevant to real-world use cases.
The internet connection was terrible. We lost almost an hour of hacking time because of connectivity issues.
Judging criteria were not communicated clearly upfront. We only found out about the presentation requirement at the end.
Mentors were extremely helpful and available throughout the event.
The venue was a bit too small for the number of teams. Tables were cramped.
Loved the energy! Best hackathon I've attended in college.
Prizes were not handed out on the day. Still waiting after two weeks.
Food and refreshments were good. Appreciated the midnight snacks.
The dance performances were breathtaking. Incredibly talented students!
The stage lighting failed during the classical dance segment. Completely ruined the mood.
The event ran 2 hours overtime. Parents and students had transport issues because of this.
Seating was insufficient. Many people had to stand for over an hour.
The MC kept making inappropriate jokes. This should not happen in a college event.
Beautiful decorations and a great atmosphere. Well done to the organizing team!
The sound system was excellent. Every performance was crystal clear.
Some performances felt too long and repetitive. Could have trimmed a few acts.
